summary: Lisata Therapeutics on 8-K reports that Kuva Labs (parent) delayed the tender offer for Lisata common stock, originally set to commence June 1, 2026 per the Merger Agreement amendment. No terms (price, premium) are disclosed. Purchaser advised it is still negotiating financing; no assurance the offer will commence. No board recommendation or advisors named. The tender offer uses a one-step cash tender offer structure, pending regulatory clearance. The lack of committed financing and uncured delay introduces substantial risk; watch for financing updates, termination rights, or potential renegotiation.
